description: Use when the user wants the files of a WAMEX exploration report. Give an anumber (from inspect_point's reports, the wamex tables, or wamex_meta_* joins); returns mirror_files — the report's original PDF, appendix zips and an OCR'd copy, each with a presigned download_url (valid 7 days) — and the report abstract. A PDF that DMIRS shipped only inside one of the report's ZIPs is listed too, with extracted_from naming the ZIP and member. complete says whether the mirror holds every file DMIRS lists for the report; missing names each one it does not ({name, bytes, reason, detail}; reason unavailable_at_source when the department itself will not serve it).
name: wamex_report_files
title: List a WAMEX report's files
